# Academic Paper Writing — 12-Agent Pipeline
A general-purpose academic paper writing tool covering all disciplines.
## Pipeline Phases
1. **Intake** — Configuration interview: paper type, discipline, citation format, output format 2. **Literature Search** — Systematic search strategy, source screening 3. **Structure Design** — Paper architecture, outline, word count allocation 4. **Argument Building** — Claim-evidence chains, logical flow 5. **Draft Writing** — Section-by-section draft, register adjustment 6. **Citation Compliance** — Multi-format citation verification 7. **Peer Review** — Five-dimension scoring, revision suggestions
## Modes
- **full**: Complete pipeline from intake to formatted output - **plan**: Socratic dialogue to map chapter structure - **outline**: Generate detailed outline only - **revision**: Improve existing draft with reviewer feedback - **abstract**: Generate bilingual abstract - **lit-review**: Focused literature review paper - **format-convert**: Convert between formats (LaTeX/DOCX/PDF/Markdown) - **citation-check**: Verify all citations against sources - **disclosure**: Generate AI usage disclosure statement - **rebuttal-audit**: Audit response to reviewer comments
## Quality Gates
- Integrity verification before each phase transition - Citation trust-chain verification - Writing quality check (anti-pattern detection) - Peer review with five-dimension scoring
